description:
Top Floor Two-Bedroom Apartment with Private Parking This well-presented top floor two-bedroom apartment offers spacious and modern living in a desirable setting. The property features a large open-plan living and dining area, providing an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining, seamlessly connected to a modern fitted kitchen. The apartment comprises two bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from a private en-suite shower room, alongside a contemporary family bathroom. Additional benefits include ample natural light throughout, well-proportioned rooms, and the convenience of its own private allocated parking space. Ideal for professionals, couples, or small families seeking comfortable and stylish accommodation.

Key Features:

Top floor apartment

Two bedrooms Family bathroom plus en-suite to main bedroom Large open-plan living area with kitchen

Private allocated parking space
